Base Electron Confidentially Submits Draft Registration Statement for Proposed IPO
By Stephen Nakrosis
Base Electron confidentially submitted a Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of its common stock.
The power infrastructure company didn't give an expected size for its planned IPO, nor did it offer an expected price range for shares.

Base Electron is an independent power producer formed by team members and affiliates of Applied Digital, to develop dedicated power generation to support the data center builder's long-term campus strategy, Applied Digital said. Base Electron is an independent company from Applied Digital.
Base Electron said it is developing grid-connected generation assets for hyperscale data center applications.

Base Electron Confidentially Files for Proposed IPO — Update
By Stephen Nakrosis
Base Electron confidentially submitted a Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of its common stock.
The power infrastructure company didn't give an expected size for its planned IPO, nor did it offer an expected price range for shares.

Base Electron is an independent power producer formed by team members and affiliates of Applied Digital, to develop dedicated power generation to support the data center builder's long-term campus strategy, Applied Digital said. Base Electron is an independent company from Applied Digital.
Base Electron said it is developing grid-connected generation assets for hyperscale data center applications.

Earlier this year, Babcock & Wilcox said it would proceed on a build-design agreement with Base Electron. The plan calls for the construction of a natural-gas and steam powered generation facility, which will deliver 1.4 gigawatts of generation capacity to supply Applied Digital AI Factory campuses.
The $2.4 billion deal will see B&W engineer, procure and construct the facility.
